text:
maria.olsen: Heads-up — deploybot is scheduled to unpin runtime 2.14 -> 2.15-canary for canary-eu-west tonight at 23:00 UTC. Observability flagged some mem growth on longseq for quant-llama3q; I want a short mitigation/rollback checklist before we proceed.

owen.kim: I thought we had a hold. Last run showed ~10-15% p95 mem increase under longseq loads. Do we have a protective config we can apply?

maria.olsen: We delayed the global unpin earlier. This is a scoped, regional canary only. Plan: partial unpin + KV-cache cap + active probes. If metrics cross thresholds we rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: unpin runtime 2.14 -> 2.15-canary @ 2026-03-22T23:00Z for group: canary-eu-west. To cancel run: `deploy-bot cancel 3123456789`. To rollback after execution call: `deploy-bot rollback --to=2.14 --scope=canary-eu-west`.

sri.patel: SDK note — client shim included in 1.9.0. Older SDKs might see 400s for function-calling payloads due to a header change. I'll add compatibility blurb to the release notes and update the SDK repo.

sam_oncall: Oncall confirmed I'll monitor latencies and mem. Please publish concrete rollback steps here so I can script them in the runbook.

owen.kim: Rollback steps (short):
1) `deployctl pin runtime 2.14 --scope=canary-eu-west`
2) `deploybot notify --role=ingress --scope=canary-eu-west` to start draining new traffic
3) If pods are stuck, infra run: `kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary` and `kubectl delete pod -l app=runtime-canary --grace-period=30`
Also keep `metrics-compare` handy: `metrics-compare --from=now-15m --to=now --metric=runtime.mem.p95`

maria.olsen: Add rollback thresholds to release notes: revert if p95 mem increases >12% vs baseline OR if error rate >5% sustained for 10m. Also call out that this is canary-eu-west only.

irene.qa: QA will run synthetic longseq probes at T+5m and T+30m post-unpin. Tagging @sri @owen for any test tweaks.

owen.kim: I'll push a runtime guard on the canary: soft kv cache cap to 8GB and smaller batching. Config snippet: 
```
runtime.kv_cache.max_memory=8GB
runtime.batch.max_tokens=512
```
(Will apply to canary via configmap override)

maria.olsen: Can someone draft a one-liner for the customer-facing changelog? Keep it reassuring and vague on canary scope.

sri.patel: Draft: "Performance update: kernel optimizations rolling to a regional canary with protective KV cache limits. No action required; contact support if you see regressions."

sam_oncall: I'll add an alert + runbook: triggers: mem.p95 delta >8% (warning) and >12% (critical), error rate >3% (warning) and >5% (critical). Linking runbook: https://internal/runbooks/runtime-canary-rollback

deploy-bot: Update: Unpin executed at 2026-03-22T23:00Z — monitors warming up. Current status: probes running. Use `/status 3123456789` to get live view.

owen.kim: First 10m: mem baseline +3% p95, ok. Longseq probe started.

irene.qa: Synthetic results T+30m: p75 +9%, p95 +11% for longseq; error rate steady. Trend looks upward but below our critical threshold. :thinking_face:

maria.olsen: Hold for now. If p95 crosses 12% or error rate >5% we rollback. Sam, stay on watch.

sam_oncall: Acknowledged — paging list updated and SRE rotation notified.

deploy-bot: Rollback command queued (manual approval required): `deploy-bot rollback runtime-canary-eu-west --to=2.14` — Approve with `/approve rollback 3123456789`.

owen.kim: Preference: pin + drain (pinning to 2.14) rather than full rollback to reduce client-side flip/flap.

maria.olsen: Agreed. Use pin + drain as primary rollback; full rollback only if pin fails to restore baseline.

sri.patel: I'll update the SDK changelog and compatibility matrix with the required shim and the SDK window (1.8.x -> 1.9.x recommended).

maria.olsen: Thanks folks. I'll open the release-note PR with the canary caveats and post a short summary in #release-notes once stable for 1h. If anything regresses, re-open this thread.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from owen.kim, :eyes: from sam_oncall)
